name: Xaak Bhaji
ingredients: Fresh leafy greens (Lai Xaak, Paleng Xaak, or Dhekia)
instructions: 1. Wash the greens thoroughly and chop them finely.
2. Heat mustard oil in a kadai until it begins to smoke slightly.
3. Add panch phoron and dry red chilies to the hot oil for tempering.
4. Sauté the chopped garlic and onions until golden brown.
5. Add the chopped greens and green chilies, then stir-fry on medium-high heat.
6. Season with salt and cook until the greens are wilted and tender.
7. Serve hot as a side dish with steamed rice and dal.
description: Xaak Bhaji is a staple side dish in every Assamese household, reflecting the region's emphasis on fresh, farm-to-table greens. It is highly nutritious and represents the simplicity of daily Assamese cuisine, typically served as the first course of a traditional meal.
